prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Raúl, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Raúl thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Did you hear that Mrs. Higgins confirmed the council is finally fining anyone who leaves bins on the sidewalk after 8am starting next month? It’s about time they started enforcing some real rules around here."
text: Can you believe Mrs. Higgins said the council is fining anyone who leaves bins out after 8am starting next month? It’s just like that time they fined poor Mr. Henderson $200 for a slightly overgrown hedge; they really need to stop making up these ridiculous rules.
